answer: What survives to the vine is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, each submission carries a fresh nonce. The river is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the voyage.
